subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should `codexbar cookie refresh` preserve the existing cached session when browser import is unavailable, or is destructive “clear now, refresh later in CodexBar.app” behavior an accepted CLI recovery contract?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes authentication recovery semantics, and the correct fallback cannot be determined from implementation mechanics alone because it trades immediate cache invalidation against preserving a still-working session.

options.title: Require non-destructive refresh
options.body: Do not remove a stored cookie unless the same invocation can confirm a replacement, or delegate the operation to an entitlement-capable helper.

options.title: Accept clear-and-defer recovery
options.body: Keep the cache-clearing fallback, but make the pending re-import state explicit in command output and documentation and prove it in the installed signed-app workflow.

options.title: Defer the command surface
options.body: Keep the existing cache-clear and app-driven recovery paths until the permanent CLI authentication-recovery contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Require non-destructive refresh
recommendation.body: Do not remove a stored cookie unless the same invocation can confirm a replacement, or delegate the operation to an entitlement-capable helper.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history shows steipete working directly on the CLI and browser-cookie access boundary implicated by this contract.
